description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.3.3
更新内容
- 独立图片编辑器：从截图历史或贴图打开图片继续编辑，支持标注、裁剪、撤销/重做、智能擦除和保存；优化大图编辑与识别的响应速度。
- 录屏支持摄像头：将摄像头画面加入录屏，并在开始前预览叠加效果；改善 macOS 摄像头采集和提示显示。
- 硬件 H.265 录制：新增 H.265（硬件）选项，在支持的设备上减少编码负担；优化录制与视频导出的帧处理。
- 历史与界面更方便：从截图历史直接定位已保存文件，应用字号按像素设置；修复取色器拖动时的透明度、贴图拖动、聚光灯和形状文字控制柄问题。
- 更流畅、更稳定：加快 ARM64 拼图，改善滚动截图与录屏资源使用，并修复 ARM64 图片渲染和 macOS 智能选区稳定性问题。
What's new
- Standalone image editor: reopen captures from history or pinned images to annotate, crop, undo/redo, erase unwanted content, and save. Large-image editing and recognition respond faster.
- Webcam recording: add your camera to screen recordings and preview overlays before capture. Improved camera capture and warning placement on macOS.
- Hardware H.265: choose H.265 (Hardware) to reduce encoding work on supported devices. Recording and video export also benefit from more efficient frame processing.
- Convenient history and controls: reveal saved captures in your file manager and set the app font size in pixels. Fixes cover color-picker opacity while dragging, pinned-window moves, spotlights, and shape text handles.
- Smoother, more reliable operation: faster ARM64 image stitching, lower overhead during scrolling capture and recording, and fixes for ARM64 image rendering and macOS smart selection.
下载选择 / Choose your download
Full 提供全部功能；Mini 保留截图、标注、贴图、拼图、录屏和手动 OCR，精简高级识别、翻译和 API 配置。Windows Mini 首次识别时下载 OCR 组件和模型。/ Full includes all features. Mini keeps capture, annotation, pinning, stitching, recording, and manual OCR, with advanced recognition, translation, and API configuration removed. Windows Mini downloads OCR components and a model on first use.

macOS 快速安装 / Install on macOS
需要 macOS 15 或更新版本。以当前桌面用户在终端执行：/ Requires macOS 15 or later. Run in Terminal as your desktop user:
Snow Shot
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.3.3_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh --edition full
Snow Shot Mini（仅 Apple Silicon / Apple Silicon only）
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.3.3_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh --edition mini
脚本自动选择架构、校验安装包并完成本地签名。首次安装按提示授予屏幕录制和辅助功能权限。GitHub 下载不畅时，可把下载链接中的 https://github.com 替换为 https://gitee.com。/ The script selects your architecture, verifies the package, and signs it locally. Grant Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions when prompted. If GitHub is unavailable, replace https://github.com with https://gitee.com in download links or commands.
